decisions.reason: The in-ear earmold fits the established hearing-care line and certified digital production, so its marginal cost is low; the withdrawal of the similar Product B points to some portfolio consolidation, but no shortfall in A is evident that would call for problemistic search.
The thermoforming unit anchors the integrated dental material-and-device workflow, has its own page, and dropping it would put system sales at risk, so performance appears to meet aspirations.

The orthopedic shoe last is distant from the core and its results are still uncertain, but it is prominently presented and slack from a growing industry lets the firm give this exploratory use of its digital manufacturing know-how more time before judging it against aspiration.
The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital and 3D-printing workflow for dental and hearing labs at low incremental cost, and it is too new to show a shortfall that would justify withdrawal.
